claims.claim_text: Anthropic says its expanded GSA agreement gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says the discounts under the agreement are estimated to save the government $1 billion.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says approximately 500 US federal, state, and local government organizations now use Claude.
claims.excerpt: Approximately 500 US federal, state, and local government organizations now use Claude.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says weekly Claude for Government active users are up about eightfold since February.
claims.excerpt: Weekly Claude for Government active users are up about eightfold since February

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says agencies are not bound by a minimum spend commitment and can pay only for the usage they consume.
claims.excerpt: Agencies are not bound by a minimum spend commitment and will be able to pay for the usage they consume.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says Claude for Government was made generally available on September 30 and provides near-feature parity with commercial offerings at a FedRAMP High authorization level.
claims.excerpt: provides near-feature parity with commercial offerings at a FedRAMP High authorization level, was made generally available on September 30.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says Utah gave Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state agencies, and 71% of them reported saving 20+ hours by the end of a four-week pilot.
claims.excerpt: Utah gave Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state agencies. 80% had a working environment within 30 minutes, 71% reported saving 20+ hours by the end of the four-week pilot.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says on Amazon Bedrock Claude is authorized for FedRAMP High, with select models authorized for DoD IL4 and IL5 workloads in AWS GovCloud.
claims.excerpt: On Bedrock, Claude is authorized for FedRAMP High, with select models authorized for DoD IL4 and IL5 workloads in AWS GovCloud.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says Claude Enterprise is in process for FedRAMP Moderate authorization through the FedRAMP 20x program, meaning it is not yet authorized.
claims.excerpt: Claude Enterprise is in process for FedRAMP Moderate authorization through the FedRAMP 20x program

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says a US state CIO confirmed their team responded to a ransomware attack in 8 minutes versus the usual 2-3 days thanks to Claude.
claims.excerpt: A US state CIO confirmed their team was able to respond to a ransomware attack in 8 minutes vs. the usual 2-3 days thanks to Claude.
